integrationOwner: Root handles centralized catalog, routes, CLI/WASM and public Worker smoke tests. This record does not assert those integration gates passed here.
limitations: Factory binary integrity does not establish full boot; simulationVerified remains false. Source-backed original factory trials are preserved.
Bare controller models retain native source dimensions. External display, camera, PoE, antenna cables and optional accessories absent from source CAD are not fabricated.
Module IPEX classification is photo-supported visual inference, not a connector BOM or certified revision. No-IPEX selection omits only native component 281.

Module DEV KIT carrier CAD omits its installed controller module. Separate native Module CAD is retained without scaling, with photo-estimated interassembly placement and an explicit UNKNOWN ALIGNMENT label; alignment is not a fit guarantee.
Actual P4 guest probes cover 27 platform profiles including documented BOOT and codec presence/NACK distinctions; DSI, Ethernet, radio and analog circuitry remain unsupported.
Model CPU Three checks do not establish browser WebGL, material decoding or hardware fit.
